teams.synopsis: Still the league's top team until proven otherwise — projected to move to 6-0 and finish a league-best 12-2.
teams.blurb: Until I'm given a reason to doubt Station Grits as the league's top team, they'll stay at number one. With Bowers and Chuba possibly out again, the WR1, WR3, and QB3 will need to keep carrying the load. I've got them moving to 6-0 and finishing the season with a league-best 12-2 record. Fantasy MVP through 5 weeks: Puka Nacua (WR1, 26.8). Current record: 5-0. Projected: 12-2.

teams.synopsis: The injury bug hit with Hampton and Lamar, but a top-three finish is still primed regardless of this week's result.
teams.blurb: The injury bug has gotten him with the loss of Hampton and potential continued absence of Lamar, but I think MFGA will be just fine. I do have the team losing in Week 6, but even with a loss the team is primed for a top-three finish. Though, don't be surprised if they drop a ranking or two before Week 7. Fantasy MVP through 5 weeks: Bijan Robinson (RB7, 22.1). Current record: 5-0. Projected: 11-3.

teams.synopsis: Patiently waiting for one of the top two teams to falter — the Wilson-Fields stack has been one of football's best.
teams.blurb: LaPorta Potty has been patiently waiting for one of these top two teams to falter, and we may see just that in Week 6. Wilson and Fields have been one of the best stacks in football this season, and combining that with the RB2 will give you some massive weeks. Fantasy MVP through 5 weeks: JT (RB2, 24.3). Current record: 4-1. Projected: 11-3.

teams.synopsis: No team has had worse luck with points against — 2nd-most points scored, but the most scored on them too.
teams.blurb: This season no team has had worse luck with points against than STD. They've put up the 2nd-most points overall, but have had the most scored on them. The next few matchups are tough, but I think the turnaround's coming soon, which is why I've got them finishing 7-2 down the stretch. Fantasy MVP through 5 weeks: CMC (RB1, 24.8). Current record: 2-3. Projected: 9-5.

teams.synopsis: Looks here to stay after knocking off one of the league's top teams — projected for nearly 122 more in Week 6.
teams.blurb: A$AP Monke looks here to stay. A strong Week 5 showing earned them a win over one of the league's top teams. Projected for nearly 122 in Week 6, the success seems set to continue, but will it? The squad's stayed healthy and avoided bye-week chaos, yet the run feels deeper than that. Fantasy MVP through 5 weeks: JSN (WR4, 19.7). Current record: 4-1. Projected: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: Projected to win by 37+ this week — don't be surprised if this team keeps climbing higher and higher.
teams.blurb: Are they the real deal? I think so, but let's see how they do in Week 6. The Minutemen are projected to win by over 37 points this week, so they should advance to 3-3, but I guess you never know. Don't be surprised if the team continues to rank higher and higher each week. Fantasy MVP through 5 weeks: Jake Ferguson (TE1, 17.2). Current record: 2-3. Projected: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: The biggest riser heading into Week 6, having won back-to-back — expecting a big game from Tet.
teams.blurb: The biggest riser in terms of ranking heading into Week 6, RWB has won their last two matchups and has come alive. Now, their opponent won't be so easy this week, so I expect it to be closer than their recent matchups. I have a feeling we're in store for a big game from Tet. Fantasy MVP through 5 weeks: Amon-Ra (WR2, 22.5). Current record: 2-3. Projected: 6-8.

teams.synopsis: Won the first 3, now on a two-game skid — needs a competitive Week 6 to avoid dropping to 3-3.
teams.blurb: After winning their first 3 matchups, the team has found themselves in a two-game losing streak. In order to avoid dropping further in the rankings, a competitive performance is needed in Week 6, perhaps even a win to avoid falling to 3-3. Can Bill deliver? Fantasy MVP through 5 weeks: Josh Allen (QB1, 23.6). Current record: 3-2. Projected: 6-8.

teams.synopsis: Uncertain how Chase will be impacted by the Flacco trade — a tough Week 6 opponent before things open up.
teams.blurb: An interesting team to rank at this point of the season. To be honest, I don't know how Chase will be impacted by the Flacco trade, but if the team continues to stay healthy, there's potential to make a playoff push. The team gets a tough opponent in Week 6, but then it opens up a bit. Fantasy MVP through 5 weeks: James Cook (RB4, 19.2). Current record: 2-3. Projected: 5-9.

teams.synopsis: There's always next year, but a Week 6 win against another 1-4 team is crucial to turning the ship around now.
teams.blurb: That's right, there is always next year, but there's still time to turn this ship around. In order to do this, a win in Week 6 is crucial, especially since it's against another 1-4 team. I'm curious to see if the manager takes more steps to win now, like they attempted last week, or if they'll just ride it out. Fantasy MVP through 5 weeks: Achane (RB6, 18.5). Current record: 1-4. Projected: 5-9.

teams.synopsis: Could easily be ranked lower, but injuries to Worthy, Warren, Bucky, and now Kyler have this team fighting adversity.
teams.blurb: Could the team easily be ranked lower than 11th? Yeah, but let's hold off for a week and see how they fare against another 1-4 team. Injuries have really plagued this team's season, with Worthy, Warren, Bucky, and now potentially Kyler missing time. Let's see how they respond to adversity. Fantasy MVP through 5 weeks: Pickens (WR6, 17.7). Current record: 1-4. Projected: 5-9.

teams.synopsis: A big chance to turn things around against another 1-4 team — the Rice trade rumors keep swirling.
teams.blurb: Big week for The Projects to prove themselves against another 1-4 squad and turn things around fast. Trade rumors around Rice have been swirling, but it seems they'll hold onto him and hope he's the spark they need. Though, will there even be anything left to save after Week 6? Fantasy MVP through 5 weeks: Javonte (RB3, 20.7). Current record: 1-4. Projected: 5-9.

teams.synopsis: An incredibly bleak Week 6 outlook — projected to lose by 37+ to The Minutemen.
teams.blurb: Week 6's outlook for Harvey is incredibly bleak, as they're currently projected to lose by over 37 points to The Minutemen. The potential for this team to make a playoff push is there, but the team just needs to be blessed with good health, which sadly won't come soon enough. Fantasy MVP through 5 weeks: Judkins (RB20, 15.5). Current record: 2-3. Projected: 5-9.

teams.synopsis: A huge week against another 1-4 team, though a projected 1-8 finish says the tank has already started.
teams.blurb: Huge week for TTF with a matchup against another 1-4 team. Up to this point the team has been underwhelming, and the loss of Nabers really dimmed the hopes of a playoff run, but as you can tell by the projected 1-8 record from here on out, I don't think it will get any better. Fantasy MVP through 5 weeks: Tyler Warren (TE3, 13.3). Current record: 1-4. Projected: 2-12.
